x_failures: Cites Atalanta fugiens p.62 for 'Emblem XI... showing the goddess Latona being purified by an alchemist', but p.62 is the Discourse XI text and mentions neither Latona nor whitening; it also attributes 'a third provides the foundation' to p.15, which only says two voices correspond to one melody.
reason: Y quotes the title page (p.7) and the preface (p.13) accurately, and its voice-to-character mapping comes straight from Maier's own epigram on p.8 (Sulfur/Mercury, the delaying apple), which is the key source on the music; its only stretch is calling the apple voice 'Salt'. X leans on the English MS title page for claims it doesn't support and ties an invented Emblem XI description to p.62.
